indications_and_usage: Uses Helps eliminate bacteria on hands.
warnings: Warnings For external use only. When using this product Avoid contact with eyes. In case of Contact, Flush with Water. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation or redness develops and lasts. Keep out of reach of children. In case of accidental ingestion, seek medical attention or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
when_using: When using this product Avoid contact with eyes. In case of Contact, Flush with Water.

dosage_and_administration: Directions From pump bottle, apply onto wet hands. Lather and rinse thoroughly.
